name: FrostWire
description: Retained source supports a narrow C classification for the desktop primary updater: HTTPS metadata/download plus an unsigned, server-supplied MD5 comparison before launch. The source does not establish an independent signing trust root.
limitations: MD5 and metadata are server-supplied over the update channel; no independent signature/key was found in the inspected updater files.
Release artifact behavior and current server configuration are unresolved.
